en: This is a black-and-white postcard showing a street scene with several ornate, historic European buildings. On the left, there is a prominent building labeled 'Hotel Wettiner Hof' and 'Bahnhofs-Hotel & Restauration.' The street is lined with trees and more large buildings. The style appears late 19th to early 20th century. The names 'Geringswalde' and 'Bahnhofstraße' are written at the bottom.
